parts.text: I worry about things happening outside our control before and during a flight, like whether the load is ready, if the drone reaches its points, and when it arrives. It worries me that radio coverage is patchy, and reports from drones can arrive late, out of order, more than once, or not at all. I also worry that the service runs on a single server, is updated and restarted during working hours while drones fly, occasionally crashes, and the companies accept a few minutes of interruption.
